prominent_limits: This is a new, unapproved shoulder-motion review draft. The installed Golem remains e056; neither V7 nor V8 is approved or installed by this receipt.

The correction removes axial material spin of the upper stone. It does not reduce total shoulder rotation to four degrees: the original aim/swing remains, with about 798 degrees of accumulated angular travel and a sampled peak near 2271 degrees per second. The early lowering, extension and overhead wind-up still include a brisk reversal.

The existing articulated-stone right arm, capped joints, socket and rounded shoulder end are retained. This does not establish welded joints, complete contact coverage, collision freedom or anatomical correctness of every pose.

The visible Ground Pound strike timing/path interpretation from V6/V7 is retained, including its earlier lowest-pose timing relative to the original corrective-bearing source. Exact preservation here is against V7, not recovery of the original source motion.

The one added skin-only control rotates around the existing shoulder-to-elbow axis. All original control worlds, forearm/fist paths and calf/foot/thumb work remain unchanged; the upper-stone surface deliberately changes during Ground Pound and its blends.

Fresh Blender import is a finite-actions check. CPU/native rigidity and preserved-field proofs do not substitute for human visual approval, complete secondary-effect validation or measured FPS/GPU cost.
